title: Fasmora 3.2610.5252 is available
message: This update improves Web App uploads, sign-in flows, Incognito browsing, tab previews, voice chat, and Passwords access.
whatsNew: Fixed file type filters and single-file selection when uploading through Web Apps.
Improved sign-in callbacks for sites that open a separate authorization window.
Refined Incognito menus and matched the browser bars to Incognito colors.
Made tab previews larger and clearer.
Added a launcher shortcut to Fasmora Passwords.
